annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 June 2023 on machinery and repealing Directive 2006/42/EC and Council Directive 73/361/EEC
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 June 2023 on machinery and repealing Directive 2006/42/EC and Council Directive 73/361/EEC
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 165/1
annotation.summary_en: EU Machinery Regulation 2023/1230 replaces Directive 2006/42/EC, setting essential health and safety requirements and conformity assessment for machinery, including AI-enabled, self-evolving and autonomous mobile machinery. It requires third-party assessment for machine-learning safety components, cybersecurity protections, data logging and notified-body oversight. Applies from 14 January 2027.
key_provisions_or_claims: Covers safety risks of new digital technologies, including AI and autonomous machinery with self-evolving behaviour.
Annex I Part A mandates third-party conformity assessment for ML-based safety components and systems.
Annex III requires protection against corruption, logging of safety decisions, and limits on autonomous machinery actions.
Manufacturers must perform risk assessment, technical documentation, CE marking, and substantial modification triggers new assessment.
Applies from 14 January 2027; notified body provisions from January 2024.
